references.name: Depicter: Horizontal Signup Form with Image
references.reviewed: Live desktop preview on 28 September; page availability rechecked on 29 September.
references.lesson: Balance a short form against imagery that explains the offer.
references.application: A useful object or excerpt should earn its space; keep visible field labels.

references.name: Depicter: Minimal Slide-in / Simple Abandonment
references.reviewed: Gallery thumbnails on 28 September; detail previews stalled.
references.lesson: One small contextual request, a short action and obvious dismissal.
references.application: Keep corner cards compact and relevant to the page. No unrelated gift or lightning icon.

references.name: Depicter: Early Cyber Week Notification Bar
references.reviewed: Live desktop preview on 28 September; page availability rechecked on 29 September.
references.lesson: A shallow row separates message, offer and action.
references.application: Reuse a good compact bar; do not invent urgency or claim a palette swap is a new design.
